releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.33 — old chats come back. A thread is now listed because its messages exist, not because a friends row does: the app asks the server for the newest message with every account it can see, so a conversation whose friendship was lost (a block in an early build deleted that row server-side) returns to the Chats tab with its whole history, appears in Friends, and shows Message in Find instead of an Add button. Tapping Add on somebody the server already considers a friend no longer raises a 409 error — the app takes that answer and switches the row to Message.
